chunks: Ḥammād al-Nawwāʾ asked him, or someone asked while he was present:
About the muhrim entering ihram in a burd, he said: “There is no harm in it. Were people not entering ihram except in burud?”

key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: a person in the state of ihram
key_terms.بُرْدٍ: a striped cloak or outer garment
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no harm in it; it is permissible
key_terms.يُحْرِمُ: enters into the state of ihram

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a muhrim to enter ihram wearing a burd?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that there is no problem with a muhrim entering ihram while wearing a burd. The statement indicates the permissibility of this customary garment in the state of ihram.
